description: This file defines the DeviceIdentity data structure, manages device identity persistence, cryptographic signing, and path resolution for device-related data storage.

classes.name: DeviceIdentity
classes.description: A struct representing a device's identity including device ID, public/private keys, and creation timestamp.

methods.name: loadOrCreate
methods.description: Loads an existing device identity from storage or creates a new one if none exists.

methods.name: signPayload
methods.description: Signs a string payload using the device's private key to produce a digital signature.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a new device identity with cryptographic keys and a device ID based on the public key.

methods.name: publicKeyBase64Url
methods.description: Encodes the device's public key into a URL-safe base64 string.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the device identity to disk as a JSON file.

methods.name: fileURL
methods.description: Determines the file URL where the device identity is stored, based on the state directory path.

methods.name: stateDirURL
methods.description: Resolves the directory URL for storing device state, checking environment variables and defaults.
